purpose: Preserve the experience, schedule and driving decisions behind Route 2 so later edits do not turn it into a generic Niagara itinerary or reintroduce a measured cap failure.
design_rules: Use overlooked towns and strange intermediate anchors to make the transfers part of the holiday.
Treat Niagara as a US-side apex; do not make the route depend on a Canada crossing or J-1 re-entry assumption.
Protect two intentionally social nights, two athletic/adrenaline anchors maximum, and quiet small-town recovery nights.
A hidden-gem option replaces an anchor; it is never added on top of an already full day.
Photogenic value must also deliver nature, architecture, craft or history rather than functioning as a photo-only category.

final_decisions.decision: Open with Smith's glasshouse, Three Sisters Sanctuary and a railway-tunnel cocktail in Northampton.
final_decisions.reason: This gives the first Boston transfer three distinct moods without a second hotel move and establishes that Route 2 is about personal, non-mainstream places rather than only famous cities.

final_decisions.decision: Pair Howe Caverns with the nearby Iroquois Museum before Cooperstown.
final_decisions.reason: The pairing balances spectacle with contemporary Haudenosaunee authorship and uses the same road corridor; it is stronger than adding another scenic overlook.

final_decisions.decision: Give the Cardiff Giant and Empire State Carousel separate rateable cards inside the Fenimore Farm visit.
final_decisions.reason: The hoax and community-carved carousel are the magical reasons for the stop; hiding them under one generic museum rating would lose the group's real preference signal.

final_decisions.decision: Keep two Rochester nights and make October 9 the no-driving day.
final_decisions.reason: The rest day supports George Eastman, ARTISANworks, House of Guitars and Radio Social without burnout, while the second hotel night reduces packing and protects the later Niagara days.

final_decisions.decision: Begin October 11 with Annunciation's Orthodox services, then use Niagara Power Vista, Maid of the Mist, Cave of the Winds and illumination as one layered Niagara day.
final_decisions.reason: Church is integrated as a real priority rather than a token add-on, while Niagara is experienced from above, below, on the water and after dark without crossing the border.

final_decisions.decision: Use an Albany/East Greenbush lodging zone rather than sleeping west of Albany on October 13.
final_decisions.reason: The east-side advance makes the final West Stockbridge stop and Boston Logan return fit the 210-minute no-traffic cap.

final_decisions.decision: Keep Day 10 at 210 baseline minutes and Day 11 at 207 only with explicit live-traffic gates and deletion rules.
final_decisions.reason: Both days technically pass the static road-network cap but have no honest congestion margin; the Capitol walk and then TurnPark are the first cuts if live navigation exceeds 210 minutes.

traffic_policy.routing_baseline: OSRM road-network duration without live traffic
traffic_policy.planning_ranges: Risk buffers, explicitly not traffic forecasts
traffic_policy.live_check: Recalculate every bed-to-bed sequence in live navigation on the travel date before departure.
traffic_policy.rule: If predicted driving exceeds 210 minutes, promote the documented replacement if it helps, remove the day's named optional stop, or go directly to the lodging city; never assume traffic away.
